title: Production Durable Knowledge Graph Reasoning Integration
objective: Integrate authoritative durable KnowledgeGraph retrieval with the existing deterministic Knowledge reasoning boundary so callers can execute validated reasoning requests against a persisted graph identified by an explicit caller-supplied persistence key, without granting persistence authority to the deterministic reasoning engine or broadening insight, orchestration, network, deployment, or publication authority.

architecture.compositionBoundary: Add one narrowly scoped production Knowledge reasoning composition boundary under src/lib/knowledge.
architecture.retrievalAuthority: KnowledgeGraphPersistence remains the sole durable graph retrieval and retrieval-time validation authority.
architecture.reasoningAuthority: KnowledgeReasoningEngine remains the sole deterministic reasoning execution authority.
architecture.identity: The caller supplies the persistence key explicitly. The production composition boundary must not derive or rewrite durable identity from AssetId, the reasoning request, graph content, timestamps, or hidden state.
architecture.delegation: After successful durable retrieval, pass the exact retrieved KnowledgeGraph and exact caller-supplied KnowledgeReasoningRequest to KnowledgeReasoningEngine.reason. The composition boundary must not duplicate reasoning validation, traversal, evidence construction, conclusion construction, or result construction.
architecture.failureOrdering: Durable retrieval occurs before reasoning execution. Reasoning must not occur when retrieval fails. Retrieval and reasoning failures propagate unchanged.

allowedBehavior: Add one narrowly scoped production Knowledge reasoning composition service or equivalent boundary under src/lib/knowledge.
Accept an explicit persistence key, a KnowledgeReasoningRequest, a dependency limited to KnowledgeGraphPersistence.retrieve, and a dependency limited to KnowledgeReasoningEngine.reason.
Retrieve the durable KnowledgeGraph exactly once for the caller-supplied persistence key.
After successful retrieval, delegate the retrieved graph and original request to the existing KnowledgeReasoningEngine exactly once.
Propagate persistence retrieval failure unchanged and execute zero reasoning operations after retrieval failure.
nonGoals: No changes to deterministic Knowledge graph construction.
No changes to Assimilation production services or KNOWLEDGE-001/003 production write path.
No changes to KNOWLEDGE-002 persistence semantics, serialization, key validation, containment, or graph validation.
No changes to KNOWLEDGE-004 production query integration.
No reasoning algorithm, reasoning validation, traversal, evidence construction, conclusion construction, or result-shape changes.
No graph mutation or revision integration.
No remote database, network, credential, deployment, orchestration, or publication authority.
acceptanceTests: Successful durable retrieval followed by deterministic reasoning returns the existing KnowledgeReasoningResult unchanged.
Persistence retrieve receives the exact caller-supplied persistence key exactly once.
KnowledgeReasoningEngine.reason receives the exact retrieved KnowledgeGraph and exact caller-supplied KnowledgeReasoningRequest exactly once.
Retrieval failure propagates and KnowledgeReasoningEngine.reason is never called.
Knowledge reasoning failure propagates unchanged after one successful retrieval.
Existing KNOWLEDGE-001, KNOWLEDGE-002, KNOWLEDGE-003, and KNOWLEDGE-004 tests remain passing.
Existing reasoning engine and validation regressions remain passing.
Established TypeScript baseline contains zero KNOWLEDGE-005 diagnostics.
safeguards: Do not commit until focused tests, complete Knowledge regressions, established TypeScript baseline, production build, architecture review, diff review, and exact staged review pass.
Do not push until the exact commit is verified and a separate publication gate passes.
Do not duplicate KnowledgeGraphPersistence retrieval validation.
Do not duplicate KnowledgeReasoningEngine request validation or reasoning semantics.
Do not derive or rewrite the persistence key.
Do not mutate the retrieved KnowledgeGraph or caller request.
Do not execute reasoning before successful durable retrieval.
Do not swallow or replace retrieval/reasoning failures.
Do not add filesystem, serialization, network, credential, deployment, orchestration, or publication authority to the production reasoning composition boundary.
commitMessage: KNOWLEDGE-005: Integrate production durable knowledge graph reasoning
